author: earl_miggers_64
title: I love how much freedom this game has.
content: I saw this game was shouted out on Alfred Scott’s Insta story and figured I had to try it out myself. And I’m very satisfied by my decision. The human aspect of having to know exactly what body part to move at the right time really makes for satisfying gameplay. Most of the parkour/free running games out there right now feel very limited and have all these levels that make you do certain tricks. There’s a level of freedom not seen in many mobile games or games in general when it comes to parkour/free running. The only mobile game comparable to this is Flip Range and like maybe Backflip madness. Some things I really hope to see in the future is, more places, possibly a slow motion feature, a playback/share feature, cool hats, maybe like whooshing sounds for when you are flipping or doing giants. But overall I can see a lot of potential in this game in the future and I think this will be good to play along with Storror Parkour Pro, (whenever that comes out).
